core_control_min_cells_note: Necessary two-group standardized AD variance domain; singleton guides remain recorded, not removed from source data
ad_tail_calibration: R kSamples ad.pval m=1 version=1, provenance-tracked dense grid with off-grid reference validation
normalization: UMI total equal to median core-control total; relative z within available chip batch
de_genes: all supplied RNA features, uninformative constant contrasts p=1; no custom ENSG/MT/detection filter
ad_zero_scale_note: Rank tests use UMI-normalized values; positive affine z-normalization has identical ranks. Zero control variance therefore does not suppress detectable DE
energy_monte_carlo_p: (exceedances+1)/(permutations+1); raw p and across-target BH q both reported; neither gates clustering
crispri_repression_filter: not applied to CRISPRko; DNA editing efficiency unassessed
cluster_variance_interpretation: Raw-UMI variance across primary cells; paper does not specify a normalization qualifier here, kept explicit rather than called exact replication
cluster_profile: mean core-control-relative z expression; exact unambiguous direct target RNA feature masked to zero; no guessed ORF-host mapping
zero_control_variance: excluded only where relative z is undefined; exclusions listed, all genes still DE-tested
inference_scope: single-chip exploratory cell-level analysis, no independent biological replicates
